subject: QBR prep: Sprint safety check + delegation grid for launch windows
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@orionlabs.com>
Date: 2027-05-17T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: QBR prep: Sprint safety check + delegation grid for launch windows

Team —

We have our leadership QBR readout next Wed and I need a concise health snapshot for the product + infra launch lanes tied to the Orion pilot. Goals for this thread:
- Finalize the sprint safety matrix (attached) with explicit owners for mitigations
- Confirm which launch windows are realistic (primary / contingency) and owners to brief execs
- Lock the delegation grid for decision authority during the blackout windows

Quick asks: please review the attached qbr_sprint_safety_matrix_v2.xlsx and reply in-thread with updated status bullets (Ready / At-Risk / Blocked), estimated delta to green, and the person who owns the escalation if we cross the trigger.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Product Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
Attachments: qbr_sprint_safety_matrix_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 120KB)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@orionlabs.com>
Date: 2027-05-17T09:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QBR prep: Sprint safety check + delegation grid for launch windows

Marissa —

Quick engineering status against the matrix (high level):

1) Model infra autoscaling (Primary window) — At-Risk
- Issue: autoscaler regression under p95 load; repro on ci-stage (see ticket INF-462).
- Delta to green: ~3 business days for canary + one config rollback.
- Escalation owner: Logan Wright.

2) KV cache warmup for onboarding flows (Contingency window) — Ready (low risk)
- Warmup hooks validated on dev and staging; minor latency at tail only.
- Owner: Marcus Lin.

3) Canary validation harness for quantized model variant — Blocked
- Root cause: missing perf counters from kernel selector (blocked by vendor patch).
- Delta to green: uncertain — vendor ETA 5–7 days, risk to contingency window.
- Escalation owner: Vivek Kulkarni (if vendor delay >72 hours escalate to procurement).

4) End-to-end smoke for telemetry and alerts — At-Risk
- Observability gaps: sampling rate on trace pipeline dropping during burst.
- Delta to green: 1 business day if we increase sampling and add short-term retention.
- Owner: Irene Choi.

I can pull a short runbook for the autoscaler rollback and a one-page exec blurb for the canary decision by EOD.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Engineering — Runtime
Attachments referenced: INF-462 (ticket), canary_runbook_draft.md (will attach after update)

Date: 2027-05-17T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QBR prep: Sprint safety check + delegation grid for launch windows

Marissa and team —

Thanks Karthik — this aligns with my read. Two escalation notes from leadership perspective:

1) Autoscaler regression: if rollback path is < 4 hours and validation is green on staging, we take it and keep primary window. Do not wait for vendor patch to block the primary. Logan — you own the rollback and decision authority up to +2 hour execution.

2) Quantized canary (vendor patch): if vendor ETA holds past 72 hours we must commit to contingency launch and cut feature parity (document which capabilities get moved to 1.1). Vivek (me) will own the exec briefing / ask for procurement to open fast-track channel with vendor.

Irene — please prepare a short note on observability mitigations and the temporary retention increase; that will be acceptable as a short-term workaround for QBR.

Marissa — please add a simple delegation grid slide for the readout: names, decision authority, and timeboxes. I'll review the final deck before the readout.

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Engineering Operations

Subject: Re: QBR prep: Sprint safety check + delegation grid for launch windows

Marissa —

Observability mitigation note: I validated two short-term options.

Option A (recommended short-term): increase tracer sampling to 20% for the critical lanes + bump retention for 48 hours during the primary window. Impact: +12% cost for 48 hours but immediate insight for incident triage. Implementation time: 3–4 hours. Owner: Irene Choi.

Option B (medium term): add a lightweight async aggregator to reduce pressure on the primary pipeline (requires 5 business days).

I'll prepare the short note and one-slide impact/cost table for the deck. Also attaching a quick telemetry checklist.

Irene Choi
Sr. Engineering Manager, Observability
Attachments: telemetry_checklist.md (stub)

Date: 2027-05-17T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QBR prep: Sprint safety check + delegation grid for launch windows — consolidated actions + deck stub

Thanks everyone — consolidating below for the leadership pack and the readout next Wed. I attached the current deck stub (delegation_grid_readout.pptx).

Executive summary (2 slides):
- Primary launch window still viable if autoscaler rollback is executed and staging validation passes. Logan to lead rollback (2-hr authority).
- Contingency: move forward if vendor patch for quantized canary slips >72 hours; cut feature parity for 1.0 and schedule parity items for 1.1. Vivek to lead exec briefing and procurement escalation.
- Observability: short-term sampling + retention bump to be implemented (Irene) — acceptable workaround for QBR.

Action grid (owners & timeboxes):
- Logan Wright: prepare rollback runbook + canary rollback rehearsal by EOD tomorrow. (Owner)
- Karthik Iyer: finalize INF-462 triage summary + attach one-page exec blurb (24 hrs).
- Irene Choi: one-slide telemetry mitigation + cost delta table (end of day).
- Marcus Lin: confirm KV warmup gating tests and attach pass/fail (48 hrs).
- Vivek Kulkarni: draft exec escalation memo to procurement and optional cut list for 1.1 (48 hrs).

I'll consolidate materials into the QBR pack and send for Vivek review by Monday morning. Alex — noted the contingency plan; we'll keep Orion updated if we flip windows.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Product Operations | Redwood Inference
Attachments: delegation_grid_readout.pptx (presentation, 540KB)
